script: Japan has three unspoken dating rules that are completely unforgiving. First, direct rejection practically does not exist. If someone loses interest, they will rarely tell you to your face. Instead, they will use a slow fade, taking days to reply until they completely ghost you just to avoid an awkward conversation. Next, paying the entire bill can actually backfire. While generosity is nice, covering the whole check often makes the other person feel uncomfortably indebted to you. Instead, you are expected to split the cost down to the exact coin. But the toughest part? You will always be in second place. Because of the intense work culture, couples might only see each other once a month, and if you complain about the lack of daily texting, you are instantly dumped for being too needy.
title: The Great Emu War
hook_text: Japan has three unspoken dating rules that are completely unforgiving.
